descriptions.pagination: Split long texts into fragments for progressive TTS playback

general.showTrayIconTooltip: Show CopySpeak in the system tray. When hidden, the app opens normally and closing the window quits.
general.autoSaveDescription: Save edits automatically 800ms after the last change on Settings, Engines, and Voices — no Save/Cancel bar
general.launchOnLoginTooltip: Launch CopySpeak when you log in
general.startMinimizedTooltip: Start with the window hidden when the tray icon is enabled. First-run setup always opens normally.
general.minimizeToTrayTooltip: Keep CopySpeak running in the tray when the window closes. Off, closing the window quits the app.
general.experimentalDescription: Turning this off pauses Auto-Save, History, Post-process, and Effects but keeps their settings and saved readings. History uses disk space; post-processing can add network use and delay. Turning it back on restores saved choices.
general.profileEffects: Effects are configured per voice profile in Voices.

playback.title: Playback Settings
playback.onRetriggerDescription: What happens when TTS is triggered while already speaking
playback.streamingDescription: Start playback as audio arrives on supported cloud engines and ready local engines. Off, playback waits for synthesis to finish.
playback.duckDescription: Lowers other apps' audio while CopySpeak speaks and restores it afterwards; off, other apps keep their own volume. Windows only.
playback.duckLevelDescription: Volume other apps drop to, as a percent of their own level

triggers.title: Trigger Settings
triggers.listenDescription: Watches the clipboard for a double-copy trigger; off, double-copy does nothing.
triggers.doubleCopyWindowDescription: Time window in which a second copy triggers TTS (100-5000ms)
triggers.maxTextLengthDescription: Maximum characters to speak (longer text will be truncated with a warning)

pagination.title: Pagination Settings
pagination.description: Splits long text into fragments so playback starts sooner; off, the whole text is synthesized as one request.

hud.enabledDescription: Shows the waveform overlay during playback; off, playback is audio-only.
hud.positionDescription: Where the HUD overlay appears on screen.

history.title: History Settings
history.enabledDescription: Save searchable readings for later replay. When off, the small speech cache still works; existing history is kept.
history.generationsFolderDescription: Directory to save TTS generations. Leave blank for default.
history.manualCleanupDescription: Run cleanup now to remove old entries and orphaned files

cleanupDialog.title: Run History Cleanup?
cleanupDialog.description: This will enforce current Auto-Delete rules
cleanupDialog.orphanedFiles: Remove orphaned audio files not referenced in history

sanitization.title: Sanitization Settings
sanitization.enabledDescription: Cleans clipboard text before synthesis; off, text reaches the engine exactly as copied.
sanitization.markdownDescription: Remove all markdown formatting (headers, bold, italic, code blocks, links, lists, blockquotes)
sanitization.stripInlineCodeDescription: Remove single-backtick inline code — off by default to preserve `terms` in technical text
sanitization.stripHeadersDescription: Remove # markdown headers, keep the text content
sanitization.stripLinksDescription: Strip markdown link syntax, keep the link text
sanitization.stripBoldItalicDescription: Remove **bold** and *italic* markers — off by default so engines can voice them as emphasis
sanitization.stripListsDescription: Remove bullet and numbered list markers
sanitization.ttsNormalizationDescription: Resolve URLs, slashes, abbreviations, metric units, and symbols into spoken-friendly text

postProcess.title: LLM Post-Processing
postProcess.description: Runs text through an OpenAI-compatible LLM before speech.
postProcess.enabledDescription: Sends each reading through the active provider's model before speech; off, text is spoken as-is, and failures fall back to the original text.
postProcess.minCharsTooltip: Runs the active template only on texts at least this many characters; shorter text is spoken verbatim. 0 processes everything.
postProcess.requireRequestFlagTooltip: Off: every read is processed, including double-copy. On: only requests that ask for it (control server `post_process`, CLI `--post-process`).
postProcess.apiKeyHelp: Key for the selected provider, created in its console.
postProcess.providerTooltip: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. Add your own with the + button.
postProcess.name: Name
postProcess.modelTooltip: Smaller models are faster; larger models follow instructions more reliably.
postProcess.promptHelp: Use ${output} where the copied text should be inserted.
postProcess.templateTooltip: The prompt template applied before speech. Builtins can be edited and reset; delete only your own.
postProcess.templateClassTooltip: Preserve: the LLM may only add delivery tags — every word is kept, and the engine must read emote tags. Rewrite: the LLM may reword freely; works with any engine.

effects.enabledDescription: Show the Effects tab in the main menu and apply post-processing to TTS playback
effects.activeDescription: Audio effect applied to every TTS playback

about.acknowledgmentsTagline: Big thanks to the teams behind these speech engines.
about.checkUpdatesTooltip: Automatically check for new versions on startup
about.debugModeTooltip: Enable verbose logging and additional status info
about.updateStatusTooltip: Result of the last update check.

importExport.tooltip: Export, import, or reset your settings
importExport.exportDescription: Copy the JSON below or download it as a file
importExport.importDescription: Paste settings JSON below or upload a file

hotkey.globalHotkeyTooltip: Press a key combination to set. Requires at least one modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win).

kitten.title: Kitten TTS
kitten.description: Local: Four selectable ONNX models (25–80MB) with 8 natural voices. Optimized for CPU with optional GPU acceleration.

qwen.title: Qwen3-TTS
qwen.description: Local: Multilingual Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice with 9 built-in voices. The model downloads on first use.

piper.title: Piper TTS
piper.description: Local: Fast, lightweight neural TTS with 20+ English voices. Works fully offline — no account or internet required.

kokoro.title: Kokoro TTS
kokoro.description: Local: High-quality offline TTS with natural-sounding voices and broad accent coverage. Keeps its model in RAM; supports GPU acceleration.

pocket.title: Pocket TTS
pocket.description: Local: Kyutai Pocket — a 100M-parameter model built for the CPU, with voices in six languages. Supports GPU acceleration.

cartesia.title: Cartesia
cartesia.description: Cloud: Low-latency, natural TTS powered by Sonic 3.5. Requires an API key and internet connection.
cartesia.apiKeyDescription: Your API key is stored locally and never shared.

fish.title: Fish Audio
fish.description: Cloud: Expressive AI voices with voice cloning. Requires an API key and internet connection.
fish.apiKeyDescription: Your API key is stored locally and never shared.

xai.title: xAI
xai.description: Cloud: Grok voices with native word captions and expressive speech tags. Requires an API key and internet connection.
xai.apiKeyDescription: Your API key is stored locally and never shared.

mistral.title: Mistral
mistral.description: Cloud: Voxtral voices with emotion, pace, and sound tags. Requires an API key and internet connection.
mistral.apiKeyDescription: Your API key is stored locally and never shared.

elevenlabs.title: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.description: Cloud: Premium AI voice synthesis with emotional range, 1000+ voices, and multilingual support.
elevenlabs.apiKeyDescription: Your API key is stored locally and never shared.

openai.title: OpenAI
openai.description: Cloud: High-quality natural voices via the OpenAI API. Requires an API key and internet connection.
openai.apiKeyDescription: Your API key is stored locally and never shared.

google.title: Google
google.description: Cloud: Gemini API speech generation. Requires a Google AI API key.

microsoft.title: Microsoft Foundry
microsoft.description: Cloud: Microsoft Foundry Speech. Requires a region endpoint and API key.

edge.title: Edge TTS
edge.description: Cloud: Microsoft Edge read-aloud voices. Free, no API key required, but needs an internet connection.

http.title: HTTP
http.description: Cloud: Send synthesis requests to a custom HTTP endpoint configured per profile.

uv.title: uv
uv.description: Prerequisite for every local engine. The installers use uv to fetch and run Python TTS packages.

setup.uvMissing: uv is not installed. Local engines need it to run.

testVoice.title: Test Voice
testVoice.description: Plays a short phrase with the current engine

localEngine.kittenInstall: Run ./install-kittentts.ps1 from the project root to install Kitten TTS. Models are downloaded automatically on first use (~25-80MB depending on variant).
localEngine.pocketInstall: Run ./install-pocket.ps1 from the project root to install Pocket TTS. Creates a uv project for pocket-tts; model weights download on first use.
localEngine.piperModels: Model files (.onnx + .onnx.json) must be placed in {dataDir}. Download from
localEngine.tempDirectory: resolves to your system temp directory at runtime.

openaiEngine.modelTooltip: OpenAI TTS model to use for speech synthesis

cartesiaEngine.modelTooltip: Cartesia Sonic model to use for speech synthesis
cartesiaEngine.manualVoiceIdTooltip: Enable this to paste a custom Cartesia voice ID instead of choosing a known voice.
cartesiaEngine.voiceTooltip: Resolved Cartesia voice name to use for speech synthesis
cartesiaEngine.voiceIdTooltip: Cartesia voice ID. Katie is the default recommended American English voice.

elevenlabsEngine.manualVoiceIdTooltip: Toggle to enter voice ID manually instead of selecting from list
elevenlabsEngine.voiceTooltip: Select from your ElevenLabs voice library
elevenlabsEngine.setupApiKeyFirst: Set up your API key first
elevenlabsEngine.setupApiKeyInSettings: Set up your API key in Settings first
elevenlabsEngine.stabilityTooltip: Higher values make voice more consistent, lower values more variable
elevenlabsEngine.similarityTooltip: Higher values make voice more similar to original speaker
elevenlabsEngine.styleTooltip: Higher values make voice more expressive (0 to disable)
elevenlabsEngine.speakerBoostTooltip: Improves clarity and quality of voice output

apiSetup.title: {engine} API Setup
apiSetup.description: Enter your API key to enable {engine} text-to-speech.

error.loadDescription: An error occurred while loading your engine configuration.

envKeyDialog.title: Key from .env is active
envKeyDialog.body: {engine} is currently using the API key from {envVar} in your .env file. Your typed key will be saved, but it won't take effect until you remove {envVar} from .env and restart the app.

engines.title: Engines
engines.subtitle: Set up API keys, install local engines, and test that each engine works. Voice settings live on the Voices page.
engines.daemonIdleTimeoutHint: Shut down a resident local engine after this long without a read, freeing its memory. The next read restarts it (~cold start).
engines.installerSmokeTestHint: Install, then press Test to verify the engine synthesizes audio.
engines.installCudaHint: Enable this when the profile uses GPU acceleration. Reinstalling changes the engine runtime.
engines.sharedModelHint: One shared model download; every listed voice is included.
engines.piperPerVoiceHint: Select voices to download (each is a separate model).
engines.uninstallConfirm: Remove this engine's files and binaries? Downloaded models are deleted. Profiles using it will stop working until you reinstall.
engines.binaryHint: Installs a command-line binary. No model download.

play.title: Play
play.placeholder: Type or paste text to generate.
play.restored: Text, voice and speed restored. Pitch and effects use the current profile.

history.title: History
history.deleteBatchDescription: This will permanently delete all fragments in this batch and their audio files. This action cannot be undone.
history.deleteEntryWithFile: This will permanently delete the history entry and its audio file. This action cannot be undone.
history.deleteEntryOnly: This will permanently delete the history entry. This action cannot be undone.
history.confirmDeleteEntry: Delete this history entry? This action cannot be undone.

success.installerLaunched: Kitten TTS installer launched in a new window

error.kokoroInstallFailed: Kokoro install failed. Pick another engine or retry the install.

info.httpEngineRemoved: HTTP engine has been removed. Switched to Local engine.

welcome.title: Welcome to CopySpeak
welcome.subtitle: Configure your text-to-speech engine to get started, or skip and set it up later.

kokoro.detail: Natural voices, fully offline. One-time ~335 MB download.

edge.detail: Free Microsoft voices. Nothing to install, works instantly.

cartesia.detail: Fast premium voices. Free tier available.

elevenlabs.detail: Premium multilingual voices. Free tier available.

fish.detail: Expressive voices with a free model included.

onboarding.kokoroInstallHint: The download streams here. Prefer to skip it? Edge-TTS works instantly.
onboarding.otherLocalEngines: More local engines (Kitten, Qwen, Piper) can be installed later from the Engines page.

effects.title: Audio Effects
effects.description: Apply a post-processing effect to TTS playback. Effects are applied in real time and do not modify saved audio.
effects.activeTooltip: The effect applied to every TTS playback. Switch instantly without restarting.

doubleCopy.title: Double-Copy Trigger
doubleCopy.description: Copy the same text twice within 1.5 s to hear it. No hotkeys to learn.

engines.title: Offline & Cloud TTS Engines
engines.description: Kokoro, Piper, Kitten, Qwen3 and Pocket run fully offline. OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Google, Microsoft, Edge or any HTTP endpoint for cloud voices.

hud.title: HUD and live captions
hud.description: A floating waveform and word-level captions, synced to the audio clock.

history.title: History
history.description: Every generation is kept unless you switch history off. Manage them in batches and export the audio.

sanitization.title: Text sanitization
sanitization.description: Strips markdown, expands URLs and normalizes text before it is spoken.

browser.title: Browser companion
browser.description: Reads your selection or hovered paragraphs in Chrome and Edge, highlighting the passage as it plays.

screenshots.alt: CopySpeak Play page with the quick controls
screenshots.caption: Play page, listening for a double-copy, with volume, speed and pitch controls

profiles.title: Voice Profiles
profiles.voiceTooltip: Known voices from the engine catalog or provider API.
profiles.templateTooltip: Prefill command/arguments/voice from a known engine. Editing afterward never changes the template.

quick.effectsTooltip: Apply audio effect to TTS playback
quick.postProcessTooltip: Runs the active post-process template on the text before it is spoken. Speaks the original text if the LLM fails.
quick.postProcessUnsupported: The active template preserves every word and needs a voice model that reads emote tags. A rewrite template like Concise works on any engine.

recent.renameDescription: Give this reading a name. Leave blank to show only its text. Audio filenames stay the same.
recent.deleteSelectedDescription: Delete the selected readings and all their saved audio parts? This cannot be undone.
